title: Power — interruption duration determines resume state
preface: This test is to confirm the POS resumes to the correct state after a power interruption, depending on how long power was lost relative to the Auto Sign Off time. **CONFIRMED (George, live-system confirmation, 2026-07-21)** — for a power interruption shorter than the Auto Sign Off time, the POS resumes via the Operator Break screen; break mode is used, not skipped. Closes gap-register.md Q18 and resolves the prior CONFLICT with C4100436 (audit 2026-07-17) — that case previously modelled the equivalent Auto-Sign-Off transition as skipping break mode and has been corrected to match this case.
preconds: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on during a shift

steps.content: **WHEN** power is interrupted briefly and restored
steps.expected: **THEN** the POS returns to the screen the operator was on

steps.content: **WHEN** power is lost for less than the Auto Sign Off time
steps.expected: **THEN** on restart the POS goes to the Operator Break screen

steps.content: **WHEN** power is lost for longer than the Auto Sign Off time
steps.expected: **THEN** on restart the POS goes to the Idle screen with no waybill printed

steps.content: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.expected: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

citations: George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — break mode is used for the sign-off/suspend destination (answers gap-register.md Q18)
TIBU-29752 (existing ref — pre-boot charge check / regression, unchanged)

title: Sign Off / Suspend — inactivity timers
preface: This test is to confirm the configurable inactivity behaviour: FLU timeout signs off via Operator Break; Idle timeout (or continued inactivity on the Operator Break screen) suspends; suspend duration auto-reboots. **CONFIRMED (George, live-system confirmation, 2026-07-21)** — break mode is used, not skipped, for the Auto Sign Off destination; closes gap-register.md Q18. This case previously modelled the FLU/Auto-Sign-Off timeout as skipping break mode ('break mode skipped'), in direct conflict with C4100360 (audit 2026-07-17). Corrected below to route through the Operator Break screen, matching C4100360's wording.
preconds: **GIVEN** the device is configured with Auto Sign Off, Auto Suspend and Suspend Duration periods

steps.content: **WHEN** the device is inactive on a FLU screen for the Auto Sign Off period
steps.expected: **THEN** the POS goes to the Operator Break screen with no waybill printed

steps.content: **WHEN** the device is then inactive on the Operator Break screen for the Auto Suspend period
steps.expected: **THEN** the POS turns the screen off and enters suspend

steps.content: **WHEN** the Suspend Duration elapses (or a key is pressed in suspend)
steps.expected: **THEN** the POS reboots and returns to the Idle screen

steps.content: **WHEN** the CloudFare activity log is checked
steps.expected: **THEN** the corresponding event is recorded in the Back Office System (CloudFare) activity log

citations: George (live-system confirmation), 2026-07-21 — break mode is used for the sign-off/suspend destination (answers gap-register.md Q18)
C4100360 "Power — interruption duration determines resume state" S2 — sibling case wording pattern ('the POS goes to the Operator Break screen') mirrored here
change_note: CORRECTED (George, live-system confirmation, 2026-07-21 — break mode IS used, confirmed WRONG as previously written): C4100436 was the sibling that modelled 'break mode skipped' ('the POS reverts to the Idle screen with no waybill (break mode skipped)'), directly contradicting C4100360. Step 1's expected outcome changed from Idle/no-break to 'the POS goes to the Operator Break screen', mirroring C4100360's exact wording pattern for its equivalent Auto-Sign-Off transition. Because step 1 no longer lands on the Idle screen, step 2's precondition ('inactive on Idle') was changed to 'inactive on the Operator Break screen' so the 3-step chain (FLU timeout -> Break -> Suspend -> reboot to Idle) stays internally consistent; step 2/3/4's expected outcomes are otherwise unchanged. Not condemned as a duplicate of C4100360: this case's trigger is inactivity-timer configuration (FLU/Idle/Suspend/Suspend-Duration), a genuinely different scenario from C4100360's power-interruption-duration trigger, and it covers the Auto Suspend + reboot steps that C4100360 does not.
gaps: Whether the Auto Suspend timer runs from the Operator Break screen itself, or whether Break first auto-transitions to Idle before the Auto Suspend timer starts, is not stated in any FBD-* spec (pos-2.findings.md flags this whole case Low/needs-confirmation for the same reason) — the chained precondition in step 2 is a minimal, non-invented edit to keep the corrected step 1 internally consistent, not a confirmed mechanic; confirm the exact Break->Suspend trigger surface on the live system before relying on this case.

The case's custom_expected summary field ('FLU inactivity → Idle (no waybill, no break)...') still says 'no break' — this field is not touched by tools/apply_rewrite.py (only title/preface/preconds/steps); needs a manual follow-up edit in TestRail to keep the summary consistent with the corrected steps.
